name: Hydrogen atom
denominator_note: rest energy of the whole atom. PER-ELECTRON would give the same number here (1 electron), but dividing by m_e c^2 instead gives 2.7e-5 -- a 10^3 shift.

name: H2 molecule
denominator_note: rest energy of one H ATOM; numerator is D0/2 (dissociation to 2 free H). Electronic binding of the atoms themselves is excluded -- molecular bond only.

name: H2O molecule (atomization)
denominator_note: mean per-atom rest energy in H2O; numerator is full atomization / 3 atoms.

name: Diamond
denominator_note: rest energy of one C atom; numerator = covalent cohesive energy. Highest per-atom chemical binding of any bulk solid.

name: Quartz (SiO2)
denominator_note: mean per-atom rest energy; numerator = atomization energy / 3 atoms.

name: Iron crystal (bcc)
denominator_note: rest energy of one Fe atom; numerator = metallic cohesive energy.

name: NaCl crystal
denominator_note: rest energy of one formula unit; numerator = lattice energy (787 kJ/mol).

name: Ice (H2O solid)
denominator_note: rest energy of one H2O molecule; numerator = sublimation enthalpy per molecule (51.06 kJ/mol). Ref table used a SINGLE H-bond (~0.25 eV) -> 2x lower.
notes: a water molecule has ~2 H-bonds (4 shared)

name: Liquid water
denominator_note: rest energy of one H2O molecule; numerator = enthalpy of vaporization (44.0 kJ/mol).

name: Moon (chemical)
denominator_note: c^2 per unit mass; mass-weighted atomization of the major lunar oxides.
notes: SAME BODY as the gravitational 'Moon' row -- both values are correct

name: Brain tissue
denominator_note: c^2 per unit mass. 78% water (dH_vap 43.4 kJ/mol at 37C) + 22% biomolecules (~8e5 J/kg, uncertain to a factor ~2). Intermolecular cohesion only -- the convention used for ice and liquid water.
notes: scale = cortical column, but B is size-independent
